notes: Expectations for build/agent6/w6/w6_kit.py on window 9, written by Agent 6 for task #19 (22:54 brief). Source of the arms: bench/agent8/run/matrix-window9.json (read-only): reference off; arms off, q0, q125, q250 and q500; repeats 3, round robin, cold run. Each arm checked in the file (cmp_arms.py, 23:01): all five have bin build/agent2/devoff4b-bin and cvars ['framerate_limit=0'] and nothing else; env off = {}, qN = {LEGO_GPU_WAIT_BACKOFF_US: 'N', LEGO_GPU_WAIT_SPIN_US: '30'}. The kit checks every run's cvars and env_set against the folder's matrix.json.

Init line, from devoff4b's source (build/agent2/snap1/DimensionsRecomp/rexlego/src/gpu_wait_backoff.cpp, SHA256 01D9F8F3464C8614..., the hash in the devoff4b MANIFEST line 'S4b A9 ... ABSENT -> 01D9F8F3464C8614'): Cfg() (L119-149) reads the env once per process (magic static) on the first hooked call. L124: on = ParseUs(LEGO_GPU_WAIT_BACKOFF_US); any plain decimal turns it ON, including '0' (clamped to 2000). Spin comes from LEGO_GPU_WAIT_SPIN_US (default 30, max 200). stats = LEGO_GPU_WAIT_STATS starting with '1'. L141-145 print 'GPU wait back-off: {ON|OFF} (quantum Q us, spin S us); stats {ON|OFF}; GetData hook {built|not built (native GPU build)}.' only if on or stats. L135/L138 warn '... is not a plain number ...' for a bad value; that text is forbidden in every run. L237 prints 'GPU wait stats (5 s): ...' every 5 s, only with stats on. Those are the file's only log calls.

q0, q125, q250 and q500: exactly one 'GPU wait back-off: ON (quantum N us, spin 30 us); stats OFF; GetData hook built.' with that arm's N, and exactly one line containing 'GPU wait back-off:', so neither warning can hide next to a good init line. q0 is ON with quantum 0, as matrix-window9 says (ParseUs accepts '0'). 'GetData hook built' is what devoff4b printed in s4b17 and s4b18 (recomp GPU build). The init line is [info], so the levels stay 40/0/0.

The off arm: Agent 1's brief says each arm's init line must appear once. That holds for the q arms, but off sets no LEGO_GPU_WAIT_* key, so the source prints no init line at all (L141: neither on nor stats). off therefore FORBIDS 'GPU wait back-off', as matrix-window9's notes say ('no LEGO_GPU_WAIT_* key, every hook calls the original at once'). An init line in off would mean an env leak from the runner.

STATS: no W9 arm sets LEGO_GPU_WAIT_STATS, so every W9 arm forbids 'GPU wait stats'. Where stats are on, the init line says 'stats ON' and 'GPU wait stats (5 s):' is required, so the kit names those lines as expected instead of listing them as NEW in the logdiff. p1 (s4b17: LEGO_GPU_WAIT_STATS=1, back-off OFF) and q250s (s4b18: Q 250 + STATS=1) are gate-only arms for the test, NOT W9 arms; if a stats arm is added to a window, give it the same 'stats ON' line and the require. Not expressible as a substring rule: the STATS line's 'sleep_fail N' must stay 0 (s4b18's gate checks it).

STUCK-LOCK and 'Minidump written to' are NOTEs (as in W6). The kit FAILs a run only when a stall overlaps run.json's measured window, and prints each episode's owner lr and function from the bin's legodimensions.map. Read the site per matrix-window9's notes: L1 poll 83FAF188, 83FAF200 or 83FBF868; L2 83FB09F0. An owner in the L1 poll is finding 10, a WARN.
